verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own card issuing and authorization controls that set rules on how and where issued cards may be used, which supports purpose-scoped cards. The evidence never says the cards are virtual, never says they can be created instantly, and never shows locking a card to a single vendor or to a category like ad spend. Missing for 10: explicit virtual-card issuance, evidence of instant creation, documented merchant/vendor- or category-level scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can instantly create virtual cards scoped to a specific purpose like ad spend or a single vendor

citations.quote: Issue and manage multi-currency cards at scale
Authorization controls allow you to specify rules around how and where the cards you issue may be used.
